title: Evidence-to-claim admission and audit chain
author: Faye Niu
target_section: 2.4 Provenance, source admission, contradiction, and auditable synthesis
status: author synthesis; non-empirical; not a result
purpose: Show the ordered evidence-to-report gates, their explicit rejected or held exits, and the boundary between traceability and source truth.

evidence_boundary.allowed_claim: The figure represents repository-specified controls and literature-based design rationale for evidence admission, exact support, typed claims, independent verification, contradiction retention, and named approval before export.
evidence_boundary.traceability_boundary: Provenance can bind a report statement to an origin, immutable capture, exact locator, transformation, verifier decision, version and approver; it does not establish the truth, authority or completeness of the source.
excluded_claims: achieved time saving or cost reduction
automatic benefit from independent or human review

generation.determinism_control: ReportLab invariant mode, fixed PDF metadata, core Helvetica fonts, fixed 900-by-1100-point geometry, and no timestamp, randomness or absolute input path embedded in the PDF.
generation.accessibility: The SVG contains a programmatic title and full description. The TXT file supplies the complete linear text alternative. The vector PDF is not claimed to be tagged.

traceability.figure_claim: Candidate discovery and source-policy admission are separate from claim support.
traceability.visible_control: Candidate discovery -> source-policy admission; not-admitted branch

traceability.figure_claim: A usable evidence record binds permitted immutable capture to an exact passage or span and version.
traceability.visible_control: Immutable capture -> exact passage or span; capture-or-span held branch

traceability.figure_claim: Claims are typed and independently checked for exact support, eligibility, time, trust and provenance.
traceability.visible_control: Typed claim -> independent verification; insufficient, stale or rejected-untrusted held states

traceability.figure_claim: Contradictory and unverifiable material remains explicit instead of being silently resolved.
traceability.visible_control: Contradiction state -> explicit conflict set, exception or hold

traceability.figure_claim: Approval and export are bound to the current named decision and content/version hash.
traceability.visible_control: Approved report/export; no-approved-export branch; edit revokes approval

traceability.figure_claim: Traceability and attribution do not establish source truth.

limitations: The chain is a conceptual design rationale, not an observed process-frequency or outcome model.
The exact source states, record fields and approval transitions are project design choices; the cited literature does not establish them as a universal standard.
Immutable capture is conditional on legal, licence, access, security and technical permission.
Independent verification and named review are controls, not evidence of automatic quality improvement.
The figure is grounded in frozen local sources and repository contracts; it does not evaluate live public-web operation, human utility or production safety.
The PDF is vector but untagged; use the SVG title/description or complete TXT alternative for accessible reading order.
manifest_self_hash: Intentionally omitted because embedding a file's own digest is self-referential; hash this JSON externally when packaging.
